title: Seamless Deployment of Machine Learning Inference at the Far Edge: An Empirical AWS IoT Greengrass Architecture for Industrial Predictive Maintenance
abstract: arXiv:2610.14815v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Industrial IoT sensors produce continuous, high-volume data streams that predictive maintenance needs to analyse in real time. Cloud-centric architectures send all raw telemetry to central servers, which costs latency, bandwidth and resilience. This paper presents a hybrid cloud-edge architecture for manufacturing predictive maintenance built on AWS IoT Core and AWS IoT Greengrass v2, with local machine learning inference at the edge and selective cloud synchronization. We deploy two configurations on real AWS infrastructure and compare them: a cloud-only baseline (Configuration A) and the proposed hybrid edge architecture (Configuration B). We measure end-to-end inference latency, bandwidth consumption and inference accuracy. Configuration B cuts cloud-bound bandwidth by 86.8% (63.6 KB to 7.2 KB per 200-reading window) and decision latency by 256x (23.1 ms cloud round trip to 0.09 ms local inference). translated_title: 机器学习推理在远边缘的无缝部署：面向工业预测性维护的实证AWS IoT Greengrass架构
translated_abstract: 工业物联网传感器产生持续的高容量数据流，预测性维护需要对其进行实时分析。以云为中心的架构将所有原始遥测数据发送到中央服务器，这在延迟、带宽和韧性方面代价高昂。本文提出了一种面向制造业预测性维护的云边混合架构，该架构基于AWS IoT Core和AWS IoT Greengrass v2构建，在边缘进行本地机器学习推理，并有选择性地与云端同步。我们在真实的AWS基础设施上部署并比较了两种配置：仅云端基线（配置A）和所提出的混合边缘架构（配置B）。我们测量了端到端推理延迟、带宽消耗和推理准确度。配置B将发往云端的带宽减少了86.8%（每200个读数窗口从63.6 KB降至7.2 KB），并将决策延迟降低了256倍（从23.1毫秒的云端往返时间降至0.09毫秒的本地推理）。在边缘，无需云端参与的情况下（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出基于AWS IoT Core与AWS IoT Greengrass v2的云边混合架构，在远边缘本地执行机器学习推理并有选择性地进行云端同步，实证结果显示云端带宽消耗降低86.8%、决策延迟降低256倍，为工业预测性维护提供了低延迟、低带宽、高韧性的部署方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an empirical hybrid cloud-edge architecture built on AWS IoT Core and AWS IoT Greengrass v2 that performs local machine learning inference at the far edge with selective cloud synchronization, achieving an 86.8% reduction in cloud-bound bandwidth and a 256x reduction in decision latency for industrial predictive maintenance.
